description: NaBiF₆ is Upper Bainite-derived structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent F¹⁻ atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 44°. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.26 Å. Bi⁵⁺ is bonded to six equivalent F¹⁻ atoms to form BiF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 44°. All Bi-F bond lengths are 2.02 Å. F¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na¹⁺ and one Bi⁵⁺ atom.
